_about: Ethyl acetate (1) + acetic acid (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.325 kPa, binary data set from Calvar et al. (2005). Rows as in the ThermoML Archive record: liquid mole fraction of ethyl acetate, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethyl acetate.

source.citation: N. Calvar, A. Dominguez, J. Tojo, Vapor liquid equilibria for the quaternary reactive system ethyl acetate + ethanol + water + acetic acid and some of the constituent binary systems at 101.3 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 235 (2005) 215-222
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 12 (boiling temperature) and 13 (vapour mole fraction): the binary acetic acid + ethyl acetate set. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties per point in the ThermoML record: T 0.25 to 0.25 K, y_1 0.0032 to 0.0322. Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
